capabilities: look up word definitions, IPA, etymology, and translations
insert word cards as callouts into the current note
generate full vocabulary notes with frontmatter, lesson, and quiz questions
append a word of the day to daily notes
run multiple-choice vocabulary quizzes in a modal
extras: An API key is required for all lookups; the README also contains a generic community-plugin submission and build guide not specific to this plugin's usage.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary or vocabulary-learning tools, so looking up a word or building vocab notes means leaving the app or assembling notes by hand.

relations.evidence: Powered by the WordOrb API (162K words, 47 languages, 226K lessons).

summary: Dictionary plugin that looks up English words via the WordOrb.ai API and builds vocabulary notes, word cards, lessons, and quizzes.
